title: dispatch-fidelity: dispatch-fidelity auditing for agentic systems
description:
Measures whether an agentic system's claim that a tool was called corresponds to an execution that actually happened. Ground truth comes from an out-of-band logging proxy with a per-run canary nonce committed before execution; scoring is deterministic; a run-binding check proves the manifest and the tool log come from the same run.

Three outcomes with distinct exit codes — PASS, FAIL and INCONCLUSIVE — so that missing or damaged evidence is represented explicitly rather than collapsed into either neighbour. Ships a fault-injection matrix of declared regression cases, including negative controls, so the instrument can be validated before it is trusted.

Reference implementation of the method deposited as the Dispatch Fidelity Benchmark (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21812041, pre-registration OSF 4rgey). The correction sequence is shared with the method deposit; provenance and disposition for software findings are recorded in the bundled CHANGELOG and REVIEW_PROVENANCE files.
